t: The Titan T2 electric pressure washer provides higher output for tougher outdoor cleaning jobs. An 1800W motor produces up to 145 bar pressure and a 450L/hr flow rate, suitable for patios, driveways and vehicles. Twin wheels improve manoeuvrability across site surfaces, while the 8m flexible PVC hose increases working reach. Onboard accessory storage and auto stop/start support efficient operation.
b: Quick Connect For Pressure Hose & Total Stop System
